title: Performance restoration of membranes degraded by fouling and wetting in membrane distillation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,1319-1330
DOI: 10.1039/D6EW00053C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Joowan Lim, Seung Mo Kang, Chanyoung Kim, Dowon Chae, Hosung Lee, Sangho Lee, June-Seok Choi, Pyung-Kyu Park
The membrane fouling and wetting stages were systematically evaluated in membrane distillation. The effectiveness of membrane restoration strongly depended on the fouling and wetting stages, varying from readily restorable to minimally restorable.
